display_name: 有界投影恢复器：固定预测独立评分修复
description: 原版完成训练并固定两总体七视图，评分因缺少原始评分模块在连接真值前失败；仅对既有预测独立评分。
authorization: 原已授权两总体七视图正式评分；不重训、重预测或选模。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI, CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty

data.representation: Original R07 L_s6300/U_s56700 paired clean/received IQ and simulated Action/noise; original source mean/covariance.
data.physical_ids_ref: R07train/physical_ids.npy roles.npy;validatedoriginalsourceLUcache IDs foralignment;officialMain source-disjoint viewindexes
data.validation_ref: Reuse original VALIDATED_ONCE R07/capsule/split and a3 source IQ moments/f57 source F0 variance. No target, V, OE or novel training.
data.support_query_ref: No targettraining/support/PCD/unknownrole. OriginalMain two populations168000,all7perrowfixedbefore independenttruth.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels. Original physical Action/noise supervision and corrected source noiseless IQ/STFT/.01 continuous frozen F0 features.
data.augmentation: Original R07 clean+six source scenes and original 30-draw order; no new source or target data.

permissions.query_use: 原两总体全部七视图、原候选/raw/DURA 决策固定后，原始 CPU scorer 对 opaque ID 关联 truth；无训练或目标拟合。
permissions.claim_scope: 仅原固定单 seed 与固定测试矩阵；测试已在研发中曝光，不称独立盲测。

checkpoint.initialization: 无模型加载：只读取父任务已固定预测及原始评分器。
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: 评分前核对两个总体、全部7视图、F0身份、物理 ID、三条读数、预测状态与原失败日志。
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: 父预测在原评分器缺模块前全部固定；无训练或查询拟合。
checkpoint.selection_rule: 固定父预测，全部维度一次评分；无重新预测或测试选模。

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only，CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES空；共享原 scorer 锁。
execution.stop_rule: 任一父预测/身份/场景不完整、原失败非缺模块、存在旧评分结果、输出碰撞或原评分器验证失败：保留产物停止。

metric_names: Original frozen ground Tri-SIG-TIME SSL Main168000: raw clean145385; each practical>=140345 and both raw clean populations separately maintained.
Original clean and six practical, per TX/RX/day groups, paired raw/DURA repairs and damage. Original ProjectedPriorDetail matched control only after all predictions fixed.
Every source epoch: unbounded and bounded projected correction NMSE, actual clipping fraction/scale, source losses, optimizer norms, posterior residual, wall time and memory.
5481223 learned parameters unchanged; bound is on per-record correction L2, not parameter count. Track source and actual deployed effect, not inferred speed.
dimensions: original Main two populations and seven views
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Fresh fixed candidate Main two populations/all 7; exact r03 raw and DURA reuse; previous detail for post-freeze analysis.

rows.purpose: 仅原冻结预测的独立 truth-last 评分
rows.scenario: 原 Main 两总体 clean 与六星地场景
rows.budget_ref: 零模型前向、零参数更新、零新预测；原有两个总体所有视图评分。

notes: 原版全部预测固定后评分因缺少 pamf_repl_view_shuffle 模块失败，失败发生在原 scorer 调用和 truth 读取之前。
原 score 失败记录和全部固定预测只读保留；新输出独占目录，采用原 F0 源 release 的评分器和共享评分锁。
源预测的候选、raw、DURA、原识别器、物理 ID 和两个总体七视图先校验，原 scorer 自身在连接 truth 前再校验矩阵。
